output.summary: The PIIA clause explicitly excludes personal open-source libraries like TraceLite and weekend off-hours code developed on personal hardware, matching the user's constraints. Exhibit A confirms TraceLite is carved out as prior IP with statutory notice. All stated exclusions align with the user's goal to avoid claiming ownership over existing personal projects.
key_claims: PIIA Clause 8.1 explicitly excludes personal open-source libraries and weekend tooling developed off-hours on personal hardware
Exhibit A lists 'TraceLite (Apache-2.0)' as carved-out prior IP with statutory notice
User's existing Apache-2.0 library and personal tools fall under stated exclusions
